card.name: Co- and anti- word beginnings
card.fires_on: The prefixes "co" and "anti" (also "Co" and "Anti") at the start of a longer medical word, often before a hyphen or a joined stem such as administration, existing, agulopathies or -emetics.

modes.label: co- prefix
modes.description: The start "co" of words like co-administration, coexisting, coagulopathies.

modes.label: anti- prefix
modes.description: The start "anti" of drug-class words like anti-emetics, anti-hypertensive, antitussives.

card.writes: It likely pushes the model toward continuing a prefixed word, such as syn- or -cide style stems.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening piece "co" or "anti" of words like co-administration or antiemetic.
